other_conditions: Applicant must be an unmarried girl
Girl must belong to SC, ST, BC or EBC community
Girl must be a resident of Telangana
Girl must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage
Marriage must occur on or after 2 October 2014
Assistance is a one‑time benefit and can be availed only once in a lifetime
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 to the bride’s mother at marriage, with a higher amount of ₹1,25,145 for parents of disabled girls.
